title: Agent experiment ledger - a PROJECTION over the one research memory
single_registry_rule: There is ONE research registry. An agent experiment IS a row of ResearchMemory.hypotheses (release=AGENTS_V2, generation_method=CLAUDE_AGENT_PREREGISTERED) plus its journal in ResearchMemory.events (kind prefix AGENTS_V2_). This file defines how the eighteen ledger fields are READ from that memory. It defines no table, no file and no second store.
failure_visibility_rule: A killed, rejected, held or abandoned experiment stays in the ledger and in the search burden forever. No verb deletes, hides or overwrites one.

EXPERIMENT_ID.rule: content-derived from family key + frozen spec; minted BEFORE evaluation; two distinct specs never share an id

AGENT.rule: the ONE signal agent that may submit this experiment's result

HYPOTHESIS.rule: an economic or statistical claim with a declared sign, stated before any result exists

FAMILY.rule: must be routed to the owning agent by agent_contracts.family_routing

FEATURE_SET.rule: must name a feature set the feature-library-agent published over a defined universe over a certified dataset

HORIZON.rule: holding period in sessions; 1-5 is the H1-H5 band; horizon variants of one idea share ONE family key

PARAMETERS.rule: frozen; a submitted result whose spec hash differs is refused

EVALUATION_SAMPLE.rule: validation + lockbox windows; the lockbox is read once

PIT_STATUS.source: AGENTS_V2_DATA_CERTIFIED event of the feature set's dataset
PIT_STATUS.rule: an experiment over a NOT_PIT_SAFE dataset cannot be pre-registered

COST_MODEL.rule: the result must be measured under the pre-registered cost model

FORWARD_STATE.source: derived from AGENTS_V2_FORWARD_REQUEST event and the frozen challenger row
FORWARD_STATE.rule: this ledger never stores a forward score; forward evidence is measured by api.canonical_forward_accrual

candidate_result_contract.evidence_kind: must be HISTORICAL; a candidate claiming forward evidence is refused
candidate_result_contract.layers: the alpha_agent.r57.engine layer statistics D (discovery), V (validation), L (lockbox) exactly as the kernel reports them, so the ONE canonical gate alpha_agent.r59.engines.gate can read them
candidate_result_contract.data_hold: a result with state DATA_HOLD carries a reason and no layers, and settles as DATA_HOLD
